# Cloud Workload Security

Apply request-level policies to cloud API traffic through a proxy in your environment

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Cloud Workload Security](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/index.md): Prevent risky changes to your cloud environments by applying policy controls to API requests with Cloud Workload Security.

## Get started

- [Get started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/get-started/index.md): Run a Cloud Workload Security proxy locally and test a policy that prevents public access to an R2 bucket.

## Concepts

- [Concepts](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/concepts/index.md): Understand how Cloud Workload Security combines workloads, policy sets, and Rego checks to validate API requests.
- [Request Validation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/concepts/request-validation/index.md): Understand how Cloud Workload Security combines workloads, policy sets, policy filters, and Rego checks to validate API requests.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/guides/index.md): Configure Cloud Workload Security policies, domain access controls, credentials, and reusable policy reference resources.
- [Configure policies](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/guides/configure-policies/index.md): Define workloads and Rego policies, group them in policy sets, and attach them to a Cloud Workload Security deployment.
- [Manage traffic scope](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/guides/manage-traffic-scope/index.md): Control domain access for Cloud Workload Security deployments and create or rotate Basic Auth credential secrets.
- [Manage policy reference resources](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/guides/policy-reference/index.md): Create reusable Rego modules, JSON metadata, and tenant structures for Cloud Workload Security policies.

## Proxy configuration

- [Proxy configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/configuration/index.md): Configure Cloud Workload Security proxy authentication, logging, TLS certificates, upstream proxies, and memory or Redis caching.

## Platform

- [Platform](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/platform/index.md): Review Cloud Workload Security Beta availability, resource limits, proxy deployment options, and traffic and certificate requirements.

## Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/troubleshooting/index.md): Diagnose Cloud Workload Security proxy startup, client connections, configuration refresh, and unexpected policy decisions.

## Legal

- [Legal](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/legal/index.md): Review Beta service terms and third-party license notices for the Cloud Workload Security proxy.
- [Third-party licenses](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/cloud-workload-security/legal/third-party-licenses/index.md): Read the third-party license notices and acknowledgments for the Linux ARM64 Cloud Workload Security proxy build.
